subject: Neurolytics: Trial blueprint, success gates & owner's matrix
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@neurolytics.com>, Samir Patel <s.patel@neurolytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Neurolytics: Trial blueprint, success gates & owner's matrix

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Objective (what success looks like)
- Measure: 95% intent-to-action match on your post-handoff routing use case across the 3 test scenarios we discussed (product search, returns triage, and fulfillment exceptions).
- Target: 70% recall at production-latency (<= 150ms median token latency) for the golden prompt set.

2) Proposed trial runway (high level)
- Kickoff & environment handoff: week of Nov 29
- Weeklies: 30-minute checkpoints (tech deep-dive + blockers) — Tuesdays 11:00 PT
- Midpoint readout & pivot decision: Dec 20 (data & eval review)
- Final readout & acceptance: Jan 15 (business KPIs + handoff to ops)

3) Owners (names + primary responsibilities)
- Customer PO / success: Elena Morales — acceptance, dataset signoff, end-user scenario signoff
- Redwood PM: Mateo Alvarez — timeline, mutual action plan, commercial alignment
- Redwood Technical Lead: Marissa Cole — integration checklist, test harness, infra validation
- Evaluation analyst: Jonas Weber — metric definitions, dashboarding, snapshot exports

4) Deliverables we will share before kickoff
- Mutual Action Plan (attached): responsibilities + gating criteria
- Lightweight SOC2 excerpt (attached) and template security questionnaire answers
- Integration checklist (in Drive link) with minimal infra requirements

Immediate asks from you (to keep the kickoff date):
- Confirm a single PO for acceptance (Elena noted she is leaning in)
- Confirm the test dataset access window and whether the samples are anonymized

I attached a working MAP (xlsx) and a short SOC2 extract that addresses your compliance question from the call. If Nov 29 works we'll lock meetings and issue calendar invites this week.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: NEU-MutualActionPlan-11-12.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-extract-Neurolytics-req.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Morales <elena@neurolytics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <s.patel@neurolytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T19:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Neurolytics: Trial blueprint, success gates & owner's matrix

Thanks Mateo — this is very helpful and aligns with our internal thinking. A few clarifying questions before we confirm Nov 29: 

- Data & privacy: our security team wants to confirm whether the trial can run in a VPC/private deployment option with customer-managed KMS. You mentioned private deploy briefly — can you confirm the minimum lead time and any license commitments for a temporary private instance?

- Evaluation metrics: for the golden prompt set you listed recall and latency targets. Can the midpoint readout include confusion matrices and example failure cases (to help our Product & Ops teams)?

- Dependencies: Samir will coordinate the sample export. We expect to have a sanitized dataset ready by Nov 24 if that helps.

If you can respond to the private deployment lead time and the scope of the midpoint artifacts, we can lock Nov 29 for kickoff.

— Elena
Elena Morales
Director, Product — Neurolytics
elena@neurolytics.com

To: Elena Morales <elena@neurolytics.com>, Samir Patel <s.patel@neurolytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T21:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Neurolytics: Trial blueprint, success gates & owner's matrix

Elena — thanks for the quick note. Short answers and a small update: 

- Private deployment lead time: we can provision a temporary Private (VPC) sandbox for trials in ~10 business days once a connectivity checklist & temporary MSA appendix are signed. There is no long-term license required for the trial sandbox; we only request a short-term commit to cover reserved infra costs for the duration. I'll have legal draft the appendix and share it as a DocuSign link.

- Midpoint artifacts: yes — Jonas will produce the confusion matrices, per-scenario error examples, and the raw evaluation snapshot (CSV + JSON lines) for your analysts. We will also include a short qualitative readout documenting common failure modes and suggested prompt/guardrail adjustments.

- Dataset timing: Nov 24 sanitized export is perfect. That gives Marissa one week to complete the initial integration and run the first baseline. If anything slips, flag it in the shared MAP and we'll shift the checkpoint.

Proposed next actions (I will do these by EOD Friday):
- Upload DocuSign appendix for temporary private sandbox (legal)
- Share calendar invites for weekly Tuesday checkpoints starting Nov 30 (we shifted to avoid Thanksgiving week)
- Jonas to seed an eval dashboard Draft (read-only) and share link

If Nov 24 dataset delivery is confirmed, consider kickoff week of Nov 30 (Tuesday 11:00 PT) so we have a clean first integration sprint the week after Thanksgiving.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: NEU-MutualActionPlan-11-12.xlsx (updated link), SOC2-extract-Neurolytics-req.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@neurolytics.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Neurolytics: Trial blueprint, success gates & owner's matrix

Elena — happy to jump in on the technical side. Quick confirmations from our end: 

- I'll be the primary integration contact and will run the first ingestion on Nov 30 once we have the sanitized export. My team will validate schema, sample counts, and tokenization edge cases.
- We'll produce the evaluation artifacts you requested for the Dec 20 midpoint: confusion matrices, per-scenario example failures, latency percentiles, and a short remediation note for each failure class.
- For the private sandbox, I'll coordinate with infra to ensure KMS/Networking steps are documented in the checklist. Expect the connectivity doc by Monday morning.

Looking forward to kickoff — I'll add the Tuesday 11:00 PT recurring invite once DocuSign is in flight.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Technical Lead, Trial Integrations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
